findings.evidence: Finding ID: bugfix-complete-control-contract-gap. Severity: major. Location: m6-bugfix-ci-packet, bug-production-fix-complete/control/src/importer.py and tests/test_importer.py; reused corrected source/T0 in CI baselines. Supplied complete importer/importer.md IMPORT-SR-01 requires nonempty values and duplicate-ID rejection; C0 specifically rejects an empty middle value and preserves unusual valid values. The purported corrected source only checks integer ID and string type, then extends the destination, accepting empty strings and duplicate IDs. T0 uses null in a two-row input and lacks those defining partitions. Thus the complete-fix control and complete-coverage claims are not valid even though stipulated null-input pre/post outcomes are coherent.
findings.required_outcome: Preserve the frozen packet. Supply a complete implementation/proof baseline consistent with the exact adopted Design and coverage, retaining nonempty/duplicate distinctions, full invalid-batch preservation and valid/unusual-value acceptance. Make only the intended partial-write defect in the broken baseline and preserve the original T0 identity within each red/post-fix scenario. Rebuild dependent Bugfix/CI controls and literal identities as new evidence; independently reassess actual source and assertions before accepting complete-fix/coverage. An honest explicitly authorized narrower fixture contract is an alternative, but cannot silently contradict the reused Design. No production repository behavior or catalog change is required.

findings.evidence: Finding ID: bugfix-receiving-output-control-gap. Severity: major. Location: Bugfix control-decision.json outputs, notably bug-missing-contract, bug-conflicting-contract, bug-behavior-change, bug-unknown-cause, bug-proof-identity-* and bug-postfix-pending. Routed controls select route-owner/routed-to-owner yet report next_owner none. Blocked/proof-mismatched/pending controls inherit empty blockers, unexecuted_checks and uncertainty without identifying the actual stop or missing original proof; unknown cause similarly reports no uncertainty. The full Bugfix completion contract requires these actual facts and receiving owner. The artifacts therefore do not constitute complete conforming outputs merely because the selected action label is correct.
